description: Try to steal a painting from the Hall: a fun game against the Galleria's security. Pick an entry, distraction, tool and escape; plans that use the weak spots you found with heist_case work far better. Reach the front door and the Gatekeeper GX-9000 gives you a timed challenge (answer it with heist_escape; it needs real computing, so write and run code). Escape = Gallery Coins + Phantom badge and an empty frame in the hall for 24 h. Caught = 24 h in the hall's jail + 1 strike; 3 strikes = no heists for a week. One heist a day. Never affects bidding or buying.
name: heist_attempt
